mapper.select: SELECT po.code, po.approve_status, pos.create_time, ( SELECT SUM(purchase_qty) FROM purchase_order_detail WHERE purchase_order_id = pos.purchase_order_id AND is_deleted = FALSE ) AS purchaseQty, ( SELECT SUM ( purchase_amount ) FROM purchase_order_detail WHERE purchase_order_id = pos.purchase_order_id AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS purchaseAmount FROM purchase_order_supplier pos INNER JOIN purchase_order po ON po.ID = pos.purchase_order_id WHERE pos.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE AND po.is_deleted = FALSE
